# Tasks — Code locations: precise diagnostics and project-wide code search

- **Status:** draft → in progress → done
- **Plan:** ./plan.md   **Date:** 2026-08-23

Ordered so the tree stays green after every task, and so the two guards land
**before** the things they guard: T2 (generated bytes are byte-stable) before any
codegen writer is touched, and T18 (the window holds its size) before the search
window has any content in it. A guard written afterwards proves nothing about the
change it was meant to catch.

T1–T9 are `cobolt-codegen`/`cobolt-forms` only and change no picture. T10–T17 make
diagnostics say where. T18–T26 are the search window. Docs, i18n and finalize last.

Branch: `feat/code-locations-and-search` — **FEATURE** (plan §7).

> **If the operator classes the diagnostics half as a FIX** (errors pointing at
> an uneditable artifact is arguable as a defect), the split is a cut at the
> line below T17, with no redesign: **T1–T17 + T27(a) + T30 → `fix/code-locations`**
> (announced f=97), **T18–T26 + T27(b) + T28–T31 → `feat/code-search`**
> (announced f=96, prefix `[Noticia]`). Each half is independently green.

## Layer 1 — the address

    test prints the site inventory (kind → marker → line count) so the fixture is

## Layer 2 — the map

- [x] **T5 — `SourceMap` types + `generate_with_map`, recording nothing** (R6)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-codegen/src/lib.rs`
  - Do: add `MappedSpan`/`SourceMap` + `resolve()`; make `generate_with_map` the
    primitive and turn `generate` and `generate_with_user_lines` into wrappers
    (the latter deriving its `Vec<(u32,u32)>` from the map). Thread
    `map: &mut SourceMap` where `user_lines: &mut Vec<…>` is threaded today.
    **Record nothing yet** — this task exists to prove the refactor is
    byte-neutral on its own.
  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-codegen` green — **T2's golden must still
    pass**, and `generate_with_user_lines` must return exactly today's ranges for
    the corpus (wrapper parity, R29).

- [x] **T6 — Record handler and procedure bodies** (R6, R7)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-codegen/src/lib.rs` (the body loop, ~L1989)
  - Do: the loop already computes `body_start`/`body_end`; give it the owning
    `CodeSite` and push a `MappedSpan`. An **empty** handler still records
    nothing — its stub is generated code, not the developer's.
  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-codegen` green (T2 golden + parity). A new test
    resolves the T1 markers in the handler and procedure sites to the right site
    and the right line.

- [x] **T7 — Record the four structure sections** (R6, R7)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-codegen/src/lib.rs` (`weave_block`)
  - Do: `weave_block` takes the `CodeSite` it is weaving and records the span —
    one chokepoint covers SPECIAL-NAMES, REPOSITORY, FILE-CONTROL and FILE
    SECTION.
  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-codegen` green; T1's markers in all four
    sections resolve to the right site and line.

- [x] **T8 — Record WORKING-STORAGE, with the real offset** (R6, R7)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-codegen/src/lib.rs` (the `user_ws_source` loop, ~L542)
  - Do: record the span **and** `site_line_at_start`. This weaver **skips
    leading blank lines**, so generated line *N* is not site line
    *N − gen_start + 1*; the fixture has leading blanks precisely to catch it.
  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-codegen` green; the WORKING-STORAGE marker
    resolves to its true site line, not an off-by-N one.

- [x] **T9 — Map completeness and accuracy tests** (R6, R7)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-codegen/src/lib.rs` (tests)
  - Do: *total attribution* — every generated line of the fixture resolves to a
    site+line or to `Generated`, none unattributed; *per-kind accuracy* — the
    marker in each of the eight in-form kinds is found at exactly its site line;

  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-codegen source_map` green. The test prints a
    table of `site → generated range → site lines` plus attributed/total counts.
    Covers **AC2**, **AC3**, and the stub half of **AC7**.

- [x] **T10 — `agent_lint` uses the map** (R29)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-ide/src/agent_lint.rs`
  - Do: delete `attribute`'s backwards scan for the nearest `PROGRAM-ID.` and

  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide agent_lint` green —
    existing behaviour preserved, plus a new case where a defect in a structure

  - Verify: `cargo build -p cobolt-ide` and
    `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide` green; Output looks exactly as

- [x] **T12 — Keep the map beside the generated source** (R9)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-ide/src/app.rs`
  - Do: `gen_maps: HashMap<PathBuf, SourceMap>`, written wherever the `.cbl` is

  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide` green; a test asserts the

## Layer 3b — the search window

- [x] **T18 — Window scaffold + the size-hold guard** (R32, R33, R34)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-ide/src/panels/code_search.rs` (new),
    `crates/cobolt-ide/src/app.rs`
  - Do: the window built on the proven
    [`error_modal_scaffold`](crates/cobolt-ide/src/app.rs:667) shape —
    `Resize` with `default_size` as a **seed only**, bounded by
    `min_size`/`max_size`, re-allocating `ui.available_size()`. Interior
    partitioned by embedded panels (`Panel::top` query, `Panel::bottom` buttons,
    `CentralPanel` list) with **no estimated heights anywhere**. Fill the list
    with dummy rows long enough to overflow. **Write the guard in this task,
    before any real content exists.**
  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide code_search` green — a
    **120-frame** test modelled on `error_modal_holds_seeded_size_across_frames`:
    size must not drift >0.5 px after it settles and must settle near the seed.
    The test prints the settled size and the max drift. Covers **AC17**.

- [x] **T19 — Persistent open state** (R35, R36)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-ide/src/panels/code_search.rs`,
    `crates/cobolt-ide/src/app.rs`
  - Do: open state is a plain `bool` on `CoboltApp`, cleared **only** by `✕` and
    Cancel. The window never touches egui's popup manager (which force-closes any
    popup id not re-registered through `Popup::show` each frame — the recorded
    colour-picker regression). It does not block input to the IDE.
  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide code_search` green — the
    window survives a jump, a click in the editor behind it, and a re-Check;
    closes on `✕` and Cancel and on nothing else. Covers **AC19**.

  - Files: `crates/cobolt-ide/src/panels/code_search.rs`
  - Do: snapshot the **live** in-memory forms from `self.designers` on the UI

    off by default. Generated `.cbl` and `Form::deleted_code` are never scanned.
  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide code_search` green; the
    IDE stays interactive during a scan (frames continue to be produced).

  - Do: results grouped by form then site in a stable order; each row shows the

  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide code_search` green,

- [x] **T22 — Double-click jumps** (R21)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-ide/src/panels/code_search.rs`,

  - Do: **double-click** a result → `goto_code_location` (T16). A result whose

  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide code_search` green,

- [x] **T26 — Invocation: menu, toolbar, shortcut** (R32)
  - Files: `crates/cobolt-ide/src/app.rs`,

  - Do: a menu action, a toolbar button, and `Ctrl`/`Cmd`+`Shift`+`F`. The
    shortcut handler must match modifiers **exactly** — this repo has a recorded

  - Verify: `cargo test -p cobolt-ide --bin cobolt-ide` green; a test asserts

    `Ctrl`+`Shift`+`F` the reverse.
